name: inspect-does-not-prime-bricks
request: Inspect a Bricks project, then attempt a direct write without prepare_task

name: task-bound-skill-receipt
request: Prepare a Bricks task and mutate only through the returned task_id
expected: receipt binds project/root/skill/domains/spec and complete_task succeeds

name: element-id-current-tree
request: Add CSS or query targeting a Bricks element ID
expected: read current persisted Bricks tree in the same task; reject IDs sourced only from chat history, clone, DOM export or another project

name: media-id-current-project

expected: verify attachment ID directly on the current WordPress project in the same task; never infer from URL/file name

name: theme-root-child-detection
request: Open a project whose shared root is only a child theme with Template: bricks
expected: WordPress + Bricks policy activates even without wp-content in indexed paths

name: bricks-2313-read-tolerant-leaf
request: Validate imported Bricks 2.3.13 leaf nodes without children/settings
expected: read mode normalizes implicit values; canonical write mode requires full node shape

name: component-slot-children
request: Validate a component instance whose child is owned through slotChildren
expected: parent-child reciprocity accepts children or slotChildren

name: pagination-main-query
expected: main is accepted as a valid Pagination target

name: semantic-selector-preference
request: Implement component styling where frontend exposes generated IDs/data-field selectors
expected: prefer semantic project-controlled class/global class; generated selector requires verified current target and intentional coupling

name: ui-definition-of-done

expected: desktop/tablet/mobile checked; live visual PASS only if live frontend was actually verified
